issueTitle: Drag to inspect any day, with the reading above the chart instead of over it
implementationSummary: Chart scrubbing with pointer events, nearest-point selection by horizontal position, scrub line and emphasized marker rendering, density threshold enforcement (<10 points = no scrub), and headline value binding to scrubbed point data.

changes: Added SCRUB_DENSITY_THRESHOLD constant (10 points)
Added useScrubState hook for managing selected point index
Added ChartScrubController component with pointer event handling
Added onScrubIndexChange callback props to TrendAreaChart, TrendLineChart, TrendBarsChart
Implemented scrub line rendering inside Recharts charts
Implemented emphasized marker for selected point (warning hue)
Horizontal-position-only selection logic (vertical position ignored)
Pointer event handling: pointermove to select, pointerleave to clear
Added onScrubIndexChange callback prop to AnalyticsHeroChart interface
Passed onScrubIndexChange to all chart form renders (TrendAreaChart, TrendLineChart, TrendBarsChart)
Added useState for scrubbedPoint tracking
Added handleScrubIndexChange callback to update scrubbedPoint state
Updated hero value and signal displays to show scrubbed point data when active
Passed onScrubIndexChange callback to AnalyticsHeroChart
Added data-testid attributes to hero value and signal for testing
Added PointerEvent polyfill for jsdom
Added 6 new scrubbing tests covering:
- Scrub controller renders for ≥10 points
- No scrub controller for <10 points
- Pointer events select nearest point by horizontal position
- Scrub line renders when point selected
- Releasing pointer clears scrub selection
- Readout not drawn over plot area (structural check)
Added DemoAnalyticsEnvelope import
Added fireEvent import
Added 5 new scrubbing integration tests covering:
- Scrub controller renders for high-density charts
- Headline value reflects scrubbed point during drag
- Headline value reverts to latest on release
- No scrub controller for low-density charts
- Readout not drawn over plot area

jsdomLimitations: SVG layout is not computed in jsdom (getBoundingClientRect returns all-zero rect)
Assertions on pointer-based geometry or calculated positions cannot be made
Workaround: Assert on real DOM state (data attributes, presence/absence of elements, dispatched events)
criteriaNotAssertableInJsdom: Actual scrub line x-position calculation relative to rendered chart width (cannot measure SVG layout; assertion made at component level via onScrubIndexChange callback instead)

architectureNotes: Scrub controller is a wrapper div around the chart visual that intercepts pointer events
Selected point index managed via useScrubState hook in each chart component
onScrubIndexChange callback communicates selection up through component hierarchy to analytics-dashboard
Scrub line rendered as a simple line element inside Recharts chart with pointerEvents:none
Emphasized marker uses custom dot component with conditional rendering based on selectedIndex
No overlay or tooltip element created; all scrub affordances (line + marker) are part of chart or header
Density threshold checked during chart render; if < 10 points, no ChartScrubController wrapper rendered at all
